content.english: God, who is concealed in the hiding place of His might,
Is found in everything, but His place is not known.
How awesome He is, and how noble His name;
Dominion and dread are with Him.  (Job 25:2)
He wondrously made His high places between His footstools,
He created creation for His own sake, and it is signed with His seals.

content.hebrew: מֵאֵין קִנְאָה בַּשְּׂכָלִים הַנִּבְדָּלִים עֲלֵי שָׁמָיו,
content.english: There is no jealousy among the separate intellects in His heavens—
He makes peace in His high places.    (ibid., cont.)
The pillars of heaven tremble, and are astounded by His splendor.
He calls by name the entire army of His hand[iwork].
Not one lacks understanding of His secrets—
Do His troops have any number?    (Job 25:3)
He rouses up the sweetness of His goodness for all.
Therefore, every ‘ir and qaddish glorifies Him,
content.comments: Ir and qaddish. Two types of angels;.

content.english: For he girds them, every one of them, with the thread of His kindness,
And for whom does His light not rise?     (ibid., cont.)
He is awesome among the thousands of thousands, in His great beauty.
A thousand thousands serve Him, to sing about Him,
And a myriad myriads are in front of Him, to glorify Him:

content.hebrew: כִּי רַב מְאֹד מַחֲנֵֽהוּ כִּי עָצוּם עֹשֵׂה דְבָרוֹ. (יואל ב:יא)
content.transliteration: Ki rav me’od maḥanehu, ki atsum ‘osé devaro.
content.english: For His camp is very great, and those that execute His word are formidable. (Joel 2:11)
All give acknowledgment to His name, on account of the deeds He has done.

content.hebrew: תְּהִלָּתוֹ מָלְאָה הָאָֽרֶץ וְהוֹדוֹ שָׁמַיִם כִּסָּה.
content.transliteration: Tehillato male’a ha’arets, vehodo shamayim kissa.
content.english: His Glory fills the earth, and His splendor covers heaven.
The throne elevates the One who is most elevated,

content.hebrew: יֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רָם וְנִשָּׂא. (ישעיהו ו:א)
content.english: The One who is sitting on a throne, lofty and elevated.  (Isa. 6:1)

content.hebrew: יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֖א רָ֣ם וְנִשָּׂ֑א וְשׁוּלָ֖יו מְלֵאִ֥ים אֶת־הַהֵיכָֽל: שְׂרָפִ֨ים עֹֽמְדִ֤ים ׀ מִמַּ֨עַל֙ ל֔וֹ שֵׁ֧שׁ כְּנָפַ֛יִם שֵׁ֥שׁ כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאֶחָ֑ד בִּשְׁתַּ֣יִם ׀ יְכַסֶּ֣ה פָנָ֗יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֛יִם יְכַסֶּ֥ה רַגְלָ֖יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֥יִם יְעוֹפֵֽף: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר
content.transliteration: Yoshev ‘al kissé ram venissa, veshulav mele’im et hahechal: Serafim ‘omedim mimma‘al lo, shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim le’eḥad, bishtayim, yechassé fanav uvishtayim yechassé raḡlav, uvishtayim ye‘ofef: Veḳara zé el zé ve’amar
content.english: Seated on a throne, lofty and elevated, with His coattails filling the Temple. Seraphim were standing above Him, each one with six wings; with two [wings] they would cover their faces, and with two they would cover their legs, and with two they would fly. And they would call out, this one to that one, and say:

content.hebrew: קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֥י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḳadosh ḳadosh ḳadosh adonai tseva’ot, melo chol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:1–3)
